newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: RUGBY UNION-INJURED HOGAN OUT OF AUSTRALIAN TEST.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-INJURED HOGAN OUT OF AUSTRALIAN TEST.

text.p: An ankle injury has forced skipper Niall Hogan out of the Ireland team for Saturday's test against Australia at Lansdowne Road.
Hogan, who sustained the injury in last week's match against Western Samoa, has been unable to take a full part in the squad's training sessions in Limerick over the last few days.
His place at scrum-half has gone to Garryowen's Steve McIvor, who is a new cap, while hooker Keith Wood of Harlequins takes over as captain.

Wood, who will be playing his first full international match since he injured a shoulder in the World Cup game against Japan in Bloemfontein last year, led Ireland A to their win over South Africa A in Donnybrook last week.

McIvor, 27, previously played for University College Dublin. He played for the Ireland Development XV against the United States in Galway two years ago and last season was the Ireland A replacement scrum-half.
This season he has been in outstanding form for Munster.
